notes.title: Demo v0.4 is now Live!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Demo Patch [b]v0.4[/b] is here with another round of quality-of-life upgrades and bug fixes drawn straight from your feedback. Let’s dive in:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Drone & Rover Retrieval Restored[/b]
Drone and Exploration Rover can now be picked up after you drop them—no more stranded machines cluttering the terrain.[/p][p][b]Universal Line-Trace Collection[/b]
Every gatherable object now uses the precise Line-Trace pickup system, ensuring you grab exactly what you’re aiming at.[/p][p][b]Smarter Build Tablet[/b]
The Build Tablet refreshes instantly when you pick something up, and its UI has been completely redesigned. Press [b]“B”[/b] (weapon equipped or not) to auto-holster your weapon, equip the tablet, and pop open the Quick Build panel in one smooth motion.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219839/f12c7ffed18bdfc25b6df28f7c76c7c2ba9a38b3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Personalized Naming[/b]
• Give custom names to [b]Production Resources[/b] and [b]Storage[/b] units.
• The Control Panel now shows each item’s custom tag right beside it—no more guessing which “Assembler 03” is which.[/p][p][b]Refined Case Drops[/b]
Dropped cases sport updated meshes and disable physics once they spawn, preventing unwanted sliding or bouncing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219839/94c5ff951efa752baeb9da62fab16d3d515b4a4b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Revamped Placement UI[/b]
Placing crafted objects feels cleaner than ever thanks to fresh visuals and streamlined controls.[/p][p][b]Context-Aware Gamepad Icons[/b]
Gamepad icons in the Menu and Options screens now appear only when a controller is actually connected, eliminating confusion for mouse-and-keyboard players.[/p][p][b]Save / Load / Overwrite Confirmations[/b]
Trying to save, load, or overwrite? A clear confirmation dialog now asks whether you really want to proceed—no more accidental data loss.[/p][p][b]UI Collision Fixes[/b]
Menus such as Weapon Select, Quick Use, Inventory, and Control Panel no longer overlap or trap each other during object placement. Tooltip stacking and multiple storage panels opening at once have also been squashed.[/p][p][/p][p]Jump in, put the new systems through their paces, and let us know how everything feels. Your comments steer our roadmap, so keep them coming![/p][p]Happy building![/p]

notes.title: New Demo Update is Live!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]
We’re thrilled to roll out a brand-new demo patch. Thanks to your feedback, we’ve made the game smoother, clearer, and far less buggy. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Build System Stabilized[/b]
A major overhaul eliminates the build errors seen in Partition mode. Constructing structures is now rock-solid and hassle-free.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Collection System Completely Reworked[/b]
The old trigger-based setup sometimes forced unwanted machine interactions and wrong item pickups. An all-new [b]Line Trace-based[/b] collection system now ensures you gather exactly what you intend.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Camera System Rebuilt[/b]
Camera glitches during machine interactions are gone. Powered by the new Line Trace foundation, dynamic camera transitions are now smoother![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219839/abc0eea97050105f5f2bb711606dd33fcf9fbcfe.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Clearer Pickup Guidance[/b]
No more guesswork when grabbing items off the ground. Tooltips now show which weapon or tool collects each material—debris, minerals, scan objects, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Machine Status Indicator[/b]
Approach a machine to instantly see its type and whether it’s running, making production management more comfortable.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219839/bfa97549435495559c74238e5242f6ba77c604a8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Whats to come in the next patch:[/b][/p][p][b]Custom Names for All Machines & Storage[/b]
In the upcoming update you’ll be able to assign a unique name to every usable machine and storage container.[/p][p][b]Line-Trace Storage Peek[/b]
When you point at a storage unit, the line-trace highlight will show its custom name and let you know what’s inside—no need to open the inventory.[/p][p][b]Remote Machine Control by Name[/b]
The control panel will list all your named machines. Thanks to those specific labels, you can instantly pick the exact unit you want and start or stop it remotely—no more running across.[/p][p][/p][p]After playing, please share your thoughts—we’re eager to keep improving![/p][p][/p][p]Happy building and have fun![/p]

notes.title: Updated Demo is Live!
notes.notes: [p]Welcome back to Mars![/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the issues and missing features some of you experienced in our demo version. This patch was prepared based on your valuable feedback. If you couldn’t fully enjoy Horizon Journey the first time, we kindly ask you to give it another shot with this update.[/p][p][/p][p]To make it in time for the Steam Next Fest, we had to share the demo version as it was. Despite its obvious shortcomings, many of you still saw the game’s potential, and that gave us great motivation to keep going.[/p][p][/p][p]While we’re working full speed on the Early Access version, we also aim to keep improving the demo and delivering new updates and content.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support! We truly believe we can build a better Mars experience together![/p][p][/p][p]-New Tutorial Guide Added: Press F1 in-game to view core system explanations and gameplay tips.[/p][p]-Crafting Balancing Pass: Resource requirements for all craftable items have been rebalanced.[/p][p]-Save System Fixed: Issues with saving and loading have been resolved. You can now safely save your game and continue from where you left off without problems.[/p][p]-Settings Menu Now Active: Graphics, audio, and performance options are now accessible.[/p][p]-Weapon Name Bug Fixed: Incorrect weapon names have been corrected.[/p][p]-Crafting UI Fixes: Issues where item counts were displayed incorrectly are now resolved.[/p][p]-Improved Crafting & Building Systems: Major bugs in production and structure building have been fixed.[/p][p]-Weapon Handling Polished: Crosshairs, effects, and collection feel improved. You can now shoot without locking onto a target.[/p][p]-Resource Gathering Refined: Collecting materials is more intuitive—your crosshair changes color when in range.[/p][p]-Scanner & Research Table Fixes: Object scanning and research interactions are now working as intended.[/p][p]-Environmental Scanning Upgraded: Pressing “T” now highlights surrounding items more effectively.[/p][p]-Lighting Overhaul: Day-night lighting balance has been refined for a better atmosphere.[/p][p]-Performance Optimizations: Smoother framerates and improved overall performance.[/p][p]-Solar Panel Visual Bug Fixed: Solar panels now appear correctly in inventory after crafting.[/p][p]-UI Improvements: Labels in the main and options menus are now clearer and easier to understand.[/p][p]-Steam Username Bug Resolved: Your Steam display name now properly appears when hosting.[/p][p]-Inventory Shooting Bug Fixed: Weapons no longer fire while navigating your inventory.[/p][p]-FOV Settings Added: Camera, weapon, and aiming FOV can now be individually adjusted.[/p]

notes.title: Update is on The Way!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Thank you so much for checking out the Horizon Journey demo and for sharing your honest feedback at the Steam Next Fest. We've heard you loud and clear and we completely understand your frustration.[/p][p]Yes, this version of the demo was missing some absolutely critical features, and we take full responsibility for that. We released it too soon, and it showed. But we’re not leaving it like this.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What Went Wrong?[/b][/p][list][*][p]No settings menu. No mouse sensitivity adjustment. No key remapping. Unacceptable even in a demo.[/p][/*][*][p]No tutorial. No control hints. No onboarding experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Very dark environments with no way to adjust brightness.[/p][/*][*][p]UI bugs, confusing systems, and a general lack of clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What’s Coming – Very Soon![/b][/p][p]We’re already working hard on a patch that will:[/p][list][*][p]Add a full settings menu (mouse sensitivity, key bindings, audio/video settings)[/p][/*][*][p]Add a basic tutorial and control reference[/p][/*][*][p]Improve lighting and UI functionality[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a number of early usability bugs[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This updated demo build will be released before the end of Steam Next Fest.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Thank You for the Honest Feedback[/b][/h3][p]We know this demo let you down and that’s on us. But your feedback has been invaluable. We're making these fixes right now and hope you’ll give the updated version a try once it’s live.[/p][p]Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]The Horizon Journey Dev Team[/p]
